name: Anastasia Petrova
source:
Job: Witch Hunter
Skill: Hand-to-hand combat,  witch-hunting
Hobby: Watching movies, reading romance novels (unironically)
Loves: Sports, especially baseball
Pet Peeve: Halloween, makes fun of the serious work she does. Never call her Ana. 
 
Anastasia is deceptively sweet for a girl who hunts and slays around 4 Witches every year. She’s a little shy and slow to trust, but once won, is a loyal and unwavering ally.

“What kind of Hunter falls in love with a Witch?”

[From the game's [url=http://kissesandcurses.voltage-ent.com/index.php/characters/]website[/url]]
